metrics.name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Saffron Beurre Blanc and Crispy Capers
metrics.stepsText: Pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels. Season both sides generously with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Allow to sit at room temperature for 5 minutes. In a small saucepan, combine minced shallots, white wine, and saffron threads. Reduce over medium-high heat until syrupy, about 8 minutes. Lower heat to minimum. Whisk cold butter (cut into small cubes) into the saffron reduction one piece at a time, whisking constantly until emulsified and glossy. Strain through fine mesh.
